<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Plastic Elephant 49</title>
<style>
/* From Uiverse.io by ozgeozkaraa01 - https://uiverse.io/ozgeozkaraa01/plastic-elephant-49 */
/* From Uiverse.io by ozgeozkaraa01 - Tags: button */
button {
  border: none;
  padding: 0.8em 2.5em;
  outline: none;
  color: white;
  font-style: 1.2em;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: none;
  text-shadow: 3px 3px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
}

button::before,
button::after {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  border-radius: 10em;
  -webkit-transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-50%);
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-50%);
  width: 105%;
  height: 105%;
  content: "";
  z-index: -2;
  background-size: 400% 400%;
  background: linear-gradient(
    100deg,
    #f79533,
    #f37055,
    #ef4e7b,
    #a166ab,
    #5073b8,
    #1098ad,
    #07b39b,
    #6fba82
  );
}

button::before {
  -webkit-filter: blur(7px);
  filter: blur(7px);
  -webkit-transition: all 0.25s ease;
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  -webkit-animation: pulse 10s infinite ease;
  animation: pulse 10s infinite ease;
}

button::after {
  -webkit-filter: blur(0.3px);
  filter: blur(0.3px);
}

button:hover::before {
  width: 115%;
  height: 115%;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
  Hover
</button>
</body>
</html>
